owner_instruction: 2026-10-30: unlimited scenarios, fine-tune on historical results, then minute intervals
label: y_NEXT_DUMP10_1

excluded_features.why: defined differently in history and in the confirm sets

selection: two candidates, fixed now: (1) BEST = the scenario with the highest VALIDATE AUC (ties: lower id); (2) TOP10 = the mean of the ten highest-VALIDATE-AUC scenarios' probabilities. Both refit on 2020-2023 and score each confirm set once
baseline: v2.4 as replayed on the same events (its own raw forecasts, made session by session) and STATIC_V24 = scenario logistic/ALL/l2=1 refit on 2020-2023 (v2.4's features in a fixed model)
bar: a candidate IMPROVES on v2.4 on a confirm set when Holm over the two candidates rejects on the one-sided session-bootstrap p of AUC(candidate) - AUC(v2.4 replay) <= 0 at 5% (smaller p tested at 2.5%, the other at 5% only if the first rejects); it BEATS CHANCE when its AUC's z against 0.5 (session bootstrap se, 2000 resamples) is >= 3
environment: scikit-learn 1.9.1, lightgbm 4.7.0, scipy 1.18.1, pandas 2.2.3, numpy 2.3.5 (pinned venv)
honesty: the VALIDATE leaderboard is optimistic by construction (many scenarios, one period): it is never the reported skill; only the confirm sets are
CONFIRM_A's labels were read once before (RECENT_REPLAY_v1, v2.4's AUC); no scenario or selection used them; CONFIRM_B has never been read by any study
no scenario is added, removed or re-tuned after --sweep; a new grid is a new study
survivorship: history survived to 2026-10-08 (3-6 years), confirm names only 0-12 months
CHART_SCALE (a fixed linear scaling with +-4 clipping) was computed over all 2020-2023 events, 2023 included; it is v2.4's frozen constant and not re-estimated here
the grid is 88% LightGBM, so TOP10 is likely near-duplicate LightGBM settings
